detail.longDescription: TLDR: I indexed 37 hours and 38 minutes of my videos using the self-hosted Docker version of my project on a rented RTX 4090 - Total compute time: 24 hours 13 minutes - Frame analysis took ~85% of the time - Heaviest plugins: TextDetection (especially on coding/screen recordings) and FaceRecognition (on podcasts) Full article here: https://iliashaddad.com/blog/i-indexed-37h-of-my-youtube-library-using-an-rtx-4090-and-local-ml-models-in-24h
